headline: Palantine Berm Clashes Escalate as Weathered Expanse Grinds On
war_summary: Combat across the northern and central sectors has intensified over the past three hours, highlighted by renewed tactical clashes in Palantine Berm where engagements around Leiri Hermanni and The Droll have driven casualty and enlistment rates sharply upward. Weathered Expanse remains the theatre's most battered ground, logging continued structural exchanges and heavy mutual losses around Crow's Nest and Frostmarch, leaving two strategic bases ruined in no-man's-land. In Mooring County, direct base turnover has paused following heavy earlier swings at Gravekeeper's Holdfast and Wiccwalk, yet meatgrinder attrition has reignited alongside mounting casualty surges in Callahan's Passage and along the Nevish Line. Across the Stlican Shelf, combat intensity has begun to cool following earlier contests over Fort Hoarfrost and The Pale House, with no fresh base conversions reported over the last two hours. Meanwhile, quiet has returned to Linn of Mercy, Farranac Coast, and Stonecradle after earlier seizures, and the southern rear hexes report negligible enemy contact.
